done_when: A change to a helper module in a test folder selects every test file that imports it, by bare name or by package path, in forge test --change and in CI; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync

known.title: Not done: Bare imports from nested test helper folders are skipped
Functional: Avoid crashing on a test helper named src.py

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - pytest has tests/nested on its pythonpath, and tests/nested/child/test_screen.py imports tests/nested/board_fixture.py as board_fixture.
The selector checks the child's own folder and ancestors named test or tests, but not tests/nested. It therefore looks for nested.board_fixture rather than the valid bare import and omits the reader from forge test --change and CI. The new test already puts tests/nested on pythonpath, but its nested child reader uses from nested.board_fixture instead, so it does not catch this failure. This leaves the owner-approved item unmet: A change to a helper module in a test folder selects every test file that imports it, by bare name or by package path, in forge test --change and in CI; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync.
findings.title: Not done: Bare imports from nested test helper folders are skipped

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a project changes tests/src.py, a test-support module imported as src with tests on Python's module path.
The new call at line 443 passes src.py to module_parts(), which strips its sole src component and returns an empty list. Indexing parts[-1] then raises IndexError before forge test --change can run tests. The same stripping also misses package-path readers such as import src.helper for a helper at tests/src/helper.py.
findings.title: Functional: Avoid crashing on a test helper named src.py

why: Related-test selection misses a test file that imports a shared helper in tests/ by its bare name (import board_fixture, not tests.board_fixture), so a change to that helper selects none of the tests that use it and a green pull request check proves nothing; seen on 20 Nov 2026 with tests/board_fixture.py and tests/test_board_now_screen.py
